Apply Today
With over 120 graduate programs, we offer the flexibility to fit your schedule.
As an R1 research institution, Drexel University provides a comprehensive interdisciplinary education with a focus on application through research and practical experience. Drexel granted its first graduate degree in 1927. Since then, countless CEOs, astronauts, researchers, and leaders across all industries have become part of our ongoing legacy of success. Whether you're a recent graduate, looking to advance your career, or preparing to change the direction of your expertise — a Drexel graduate program can help position you for success.
Graduate Applications Are Now Open
You're ready to take your place among the next generation of leadership at Drexel University. Graduate admission requirements vary by program. For full details, refer to Drexel’s official Graduate Admissions Application Instructions.

What you bring to the table. Graduate studies at Drexel University.
Drexel granted its first graduate degree in 1927. Since then, countless CEOs, astronauts, researchers, and leaders across all industries have shared their experiences with our community and have made their ambition the Drexel story.
The Drexel Graduate Student Experience
With our unique combination of advanced academics and real-world opportunities, pursuing graduate studies at Drexel will allow you to leverage the knowledge you already have and broaden the scope of your education. Visit our Graduate Virtual Experience to get a better look at what Drexel can offer you.
Our Dragons hail from locations around the globe, and Drexel is committed to providing both our graduate student-veterans and international students with a supportive, welcoming environment that values their individual voices and enhanced global perspectives. The Office of Graduate Studies is committed to the success
of every graduate student, overseeing all graduate programs and graduate
student organizations across the University.
Financial Support for Graduate Students
Financial aid is available to graduate students primarily through student loans, assistantships, merit-based scholarships, tuition remission, and incentive programs.
Drexel's Home in Philadelphia
Located in the sixth largest city in the U.S., Drexel considers Philadelphia, PA to be an extension of its campus. Our graduate students aren't just studying in this historical landmark — they are conducting research, solving the city's business problems, and deeply engaged in the community. And as the birthplace of the country and the U.S.’s first and only World Heritage City, there’s so much to explore in Philadelphia. No matter if you decide to study full-time, part-time, on campus, or online, our connection to this great city will open doors you won't find anywhere else.
A City of Brotherly Love: Philadelphia
The City of Brotherly Love and the home of Drexel University, Philadelphia is known for its cultural diversity, rich history, and passionate residents. At the heart of Philly is a sense of humanity and the idea that there is always room for change, innovation, and expanding the boundaries of what we can achieve.
